study: Phase 3 V6 matched cohort common-support and reference-balance audit V8
inputs: Archived outcome-blind V6 pairs and independently rebuilt frozen eligible pre-event covariates
reference_scale: Within definition x asset x direction, pooled sample SD of the two full eligible sequence classes before matching
distribution_support: Intersection of each class's 5th-95th percentile interval divided by the union interval; descriptive range-overlap diagnostic, not a density-overlap estimator
matched_support: Fraction of matched endpoints inside the shared central 90% interval

thresholds.abs_smd_0_10: reported diagnostic only; not an automatic acceptance threshold
thresholds.abs_smd_0_20: reported diagnostic only; not an automatic rejection threshold

limitations: central-range overlap is not full distributional equivalence
small asset-direction matched samples remain unstable
reference SD standardizes differences but does not prove exchangeability
broad and strict cohorts are nested
no outcomes are loaded or compared; no trading inference is made
